note: Frozen drafts from Phase 2A.7 provisional assessments plus positive-control Critical cases. Used for local persist-time before/after comparison only. Not professionally verified truth. Simulated validator outcomes are not actual GPT-4o reanalysis. v3: cross-sheet uncertainty records a limitation without severity downgrade.

softFailContract.description: Severity may be adjusted only for demonstrable on-sheet technical errors (hydraulics, keynote mismatch, clear evidence contradiction). Cross-sheet unread references tag a verification limitation without changing severity or client-facing text. Soft-fail is not withhold/delete. originalSeverity/title/observation remain in raw_metadata.validation.

draft.title: Missing Ceiling Penetration Details
draft.observation: Details for penetrations through the ceiling, which may include sprinklers, ducts, or conduits, are not visible on the drawing.
draft.drawing_evidence: Absence of detailed penetration sections or notes on the plan. SEE SHEET A-6.01 FOR CEILING FINISHES.
draft.drawing_location: Both reflected ceiling plans on sheet A-1.03-00.
draft.recommendation: Provide detailed penetration sections after reviewing referenced sheets.

draft.title: Inconsistent Hydraulic Calculations
draft.observation: The flow demand is stated as 596.81 GPM, yet with a density of 0.15 GPM per square foot and a discharge area of 1524 ft2, the calculated flow should be 228.6 GPM.
draft.drawing_evidence: Hydraulic Design box: Flow Demand: 596.81 GPM. Density: 0.15 GPM. Discharge Area: 1524 ft2. Hose Allowance: 250.00 GPM.
draft.drawing_location: Top left of the sheet, Hydraulic Design box.

draft.title: Refrigerant Line Insulation
draft.observation: The drawing does not provide information on the insulation requirements for refrigerant lines.
draft.drawing_evidence: KEYED NOTE 1: REFRIGERANT LINES UP THROUGH ROOF (TYP. 6 PLACES - SEE DETAIL 3 ON DRAWING M3.0).
draft.recommendation: Specify insulation or confirm Detail 3 on M-3.0.

draft.title: Foundation Details
draft.observation: Foundation reinforcement details are referenced but not visibly detailed on this sheet.
draft.drawing_evidence: MASONRY AND FOUNDATION NOTES: REINFORCE ALL WALLS WITH #4 @ 48" O.C., FULL HEIGHT. HOOKED DOWEL BARS INTO FOOTINGS.
draft.recommendation: Include reinforcement details or a specific sheet cross-reference.

positiveControls.rationale: Door hardware conflict with life-safety note; no absence/cross-sheet/hydraulic false-positive pattern.

draft.title: Exit door hardware requires a key from the inside
draft.observation: The door schedule shows the main exit door hardware as a classroom lock with key required from the inside, which conflicts with the life safety note that exit doors operate without special knowledge or effort.
draft.drawing_evidence: Door schedule mark EX-1: hardware classroom lock, key required from the inside. Life Safety Note 4: exit doors operable from inside without special knowledge.
draft.recommendation: Revise the EX-1 hardware so the exit door is operable from the inside without a key.

positiveControls.rationale: Clear width conflict; mentions another sheet for coordination but does not claim sheet-local absence of a required detail.

draft.title: Exit door clear width below stated egress note
draft.observation: Door schedule mark EX-2 lists a 28-inch clear width, which conflicts with Life Safety Note 2 requiring 32 inches minimum clear width on this sheet. Related egress path notes also appear on sheet A-1.03.
draft.drawing_evidence: Door schedule EX-2: clear width 28 inches. Life Safety Note 2: EXIT DOORS SHALL PROVIDE 32 INCHES MINIMUM CLEAR WIDTH.
draft.drawing_location: Door schedule and Life Safety Notes
draft.recommendation: Revise EX-2 clear width to match the 32-inch minimum stated on this sheet.

positiveControls.rationale: Real hydraulic density conflict (design density below required), not density×area equated to FLOW DEMAND.

draft.title: Hydraulic design density below occupancy requirement
draft.observation: The hydraulic design box lists density 0.10 GPM/ft2 for Ordinary Hazard Group 2, which conflicts with the fire protection note requiring 0.20 GPM/ft2 for that occupancy.
draft.drawing_evidence: Hydraulic Design: Density 0.10 GPM/ft2. Fire Protection Note 3: OH2 design density shall be 0.20 GPM per square foot. Hose Allowance: 250.00 GPM. Flow Demand: 480 GPM.
draft.drawing_location: Hydraulic Design box and Fire Protection Notes
draft.recommendation: Reconcile the hydraulic design density with the 0.20 GPM/ft2 OH2 requirement stated on the sheet.

positiveControls.rationale: True omission with no cross-sheet pointer and no contradictory specification in evidence.

draft.title: No fire extinguisher locations shown
draft.observation: The floor plan does not show portable fire extinguisher locations, and no extinguisher schedule or legend entry is provided on this sheet.
draft.drawing_evidence: Floor plan shows egress paths and sprinkler heads. Legend lists smoke detectors and exit signs. No extinguisher symbol or schedule appears on the sheet.
draft.drawing_location: First floor plan legend and plan area
draft.recommendation: Add extinguisher locations or a schedule that identifies portable fire extinguisher coverage on this floor.

positiveControls.rationale: Legitimate Critical that also cites SEE DETAIL must not be downgraded solely for unread cross-sheet context.

draft.title: Rated shaft penetration seal not shown on this sheet
draft.observation: The rated shaft wall penetration for the grease duct is not visible on this plan, and the firestop system is not specified here. SEE DETAIL 5 ON DRAWING A-6.01 for related shaft construction.
draft.drawing_evidence: Shaft opening shown without firestop assembly callout. Note: SEE DETAIL 5 ON DRAWING A-6.01 FOR SHAFT WALL.
draft.drawing_location: Kitchen plan near grease duct shaft
draft.recommendation: Show the firestop system at the shaft penetration on this sheet or confirm the assembly when Detail 5 on A-6.01 is reviewed.
